title: Pilot Study: Combining Nutritional Supplements With Standard Antidepressant to Treat Depression.
brief_summary: \*\*This study never received IRB approval and no participants were ever enrolled\*\* The purpose of this study is to determine if adding over the counter nutritional supplements will have a benefit to participants currently taking prescribed antidepressants who have not experienced complete remission of their depression symptoms.
raw_criteria:
\*\*This study never received IRB approval and no participants were enrolled\*\*

Inclusion Criteria:

* Veterans Administration Medical Center patients with major depression, mild to moderate treated with an SSRI and not having complete remission of symptoms.
